terrains.name: A lush forest floor covered in vibrant green grass, patches of moss, scattered fallen leaves, small stones, and occasional wildflowers, creating a natural woodland path.
A dense forest canopy featuring towering trees, thick leafy bushes, tangled vines, moss-covered rocks, and overlapping foliage that forms a natural boundary around the forest floor.
